title: United Republic of Tanzania Country Climate and Development Report: Executive Summary
temporal_coverage: Current climate-risk exposure and climate-development scenarios through 2050, reported in 2024
methodology: CCDR executive summary reports macroeconomic, climate, sectoral, institutional and financial modeling under climate and growth scenarios.
limitations: Summary-level results are modeled and scenario-dependent; detailed methods are outside this executive summary.

title: Tanzania's Nationally Determined Contribution
organization: United Republic of Tanzania, Vice President's Office (Union and Environment)
temporal_coverage: Observed climate through 2016 and projections through 2090 reported in the 2021 NDC
methodology: NDC draws on the Second National Communication, national adaptation planning and cited Future Climate for Africa projections.
limitations: NDC reports results from earlier studies; its climate-risk assessment methods were still to be developed when submitted.
